ns2:section.sectionText: Course prerequisites: Students are expected to have strong knowledge of linear algebra, realanalysis and probability theory. Some prior exposure to optimization at a graduate level is preferred. The course will cover a variety of advanced topics in optimization theory, algorithms, and applications in machine learning. The aim is to expose students to modern algorithmic developments in convex optimization (smooth, non-smooth, deterministic, stochastic, and online) and bring them near the frontier of current resarch in large-scale optimization and machine learning.
